Convert long-format activity results to a source-by-sample matrix

Source: R/result-inputs.R
activity_matrix.Rd

Convert long-format activity results to a source-by-sample matrix

Usage

activity_matrix(
  result,
  value = "score",
  source = "source",
  sample = "condition",
  statistic = NULL,
  statistic_column = "statistic"
)

Arguments

result

A data-frame-like result returned by activity_decouple(), activity_progeny(), or activity_tf().

value, source, sample

Column names containing activity values, sources, and sample identifiers.

statistic

Optional statistic/method value to retain when a result contains multiple methods.

statistic_column

Column containing statistic/method names.

Value

A numeric source-by-sample matrix suitable for mae_add_experiment().
